test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence and forms a meaningful sentence. The first part

'He wrapped himself' is fixed. He wrapped himself / two sweatshirts (P) / with a blanket, (Q) / was wearing (R) / though he (S)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **QSRP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence starts with the fixed phrase "He wrapped himself," which is followed logically by **Q** ("with a blanket").
 
• Next, **S** ("though he") introduces a contrast, setting up the sentence structure.
 
• Then, **R** ("was wearing") follows naturally, linking the subject to the next phrase.
 
• Finally, **P** ("two sweatshirts") completes the sentence by specifying what he was wearing.

Therefore, the correct answer is **QSRP**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (QRPS):** This order disrupts the logical sequence by introducing "was wearing" before establishing contrast with "though he."
 
• **Option 3 (PQSR):** This option misplaces "two sweatshirts" at the beginning, making the sentence sound unnatural.
 
• **Option 4 (SPRQ):** Starting with "though he" disrupts the natural sentence flow, leading to incorrect structure.
